purpose: Assemble complete, deterministic, traceable production context from CSD-011 visual specifications for downstream prompt compilation and provider routing.
core_principle: Context assembly preserves source intent and lineage; it does not invent narrative meaning, select providers, or silently rewrite identity.

prompt_assembly_contract.positive_prompt: Ordered semantic representation of approved visual intent; not provider syntax.
prompt_assembly_contract.negative_prompt: Explicit prohibited visual outcomes derived from identity, continuity, knowledge, perception and style constraints.
prompt_assembly_contract.reference_manifest: Typed references with role, immutability, source lineage and allowed usage.
prompt_assembly_contract.context_priority: Identity > canonical reality > continuity > performance > perception > action > environment > camera > lighting > style.

reference_rules: Immutable trusted references must retain their source identity.
A derived provider proxy cannot silently replace an immutable canonical reference.
Reference roles must be explicit: IDENTITY, COMPOSITION, ENVIRONMENT, STYLE, CONTINUITY or PERFORMANCE.
Reference assets cannot introduce facts absent from the approved scene context.
Reference usage must be traceable to a frame and source asset.
assembly_rules: Do not create new story facts.
Do not upgrade belief to fact.
Do not leak audience-only information into subjective context.
Do not convert internal emotion into unsupported physical events.
Do not alter canonical character identity.
Do not add characters beyond the approved active set.
Preserve all CSD-011 continuity and negative constraints.
Positive and negative semantics must not contradict each other.
Every assembled field must have provenance or be an explicit production default.

pass_conditions: reference manifest is typed and traceable
positive and negative semantics are internally consistent

context.performance: Ravana contained intensity with challenged curiosity; Rama calm and unchanged
context.knowledge_boundary: Ravana does not know Rama's complete internal reasoning
context.canonical_reality: Mount Kailash confrontation; power has been deliberately restrained
context.camera_semantics: subjective medium-close aligned to Ravana's attention
negative_constraints: no omniscient representation of Rama's thoughts
